assets.name: rise
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent 2D cat animation transition sprite atlas.
References: Image 1 is the approved seated cream-white cat and face identity. Image 2 is its existing running sheet (first cell is the run contact pose). Image 3 is its existing jumping sheet (first cell is the neutral standing pose, second cell the crouch, seventh cell the landing).
Make ONE landscape 2:1 image with EXACTLY EIGHT sprites in a strict equal FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid. Order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each cell one full cat, with SAME head size and overall anatomical scale across all cells. Full tail and all paws included. Every silhouette wholly inside central 74% of its cell width; minimum clear transparent margin 10% on all sides. Real alpha transparency, no checkerboard drawn, no shadows, no background, no text, no lines. Keep the painterly cream and warm gray fur, visible angular brushwork, pink inner ears, blue-gray eyes, rounded shorthair face. Constant camera/lighting. These are consecutive frames of ONE cat, no sudden style/size change. Do not stretch the body to fit each cell; natural crouching changes height, not scale. Feet have a common level at 86% cell height, all cells use identical body scale. Natural quadruped anatomy, no accessories.
Action: SEATED TO FOUR-PAW STANDING. Face and body turn only slightly from reference seated three-quarter right toward reference standing three-quarter right. Eight smooth evenly spaced in-between poses:
0 exactly the seated reference posture, tail curled across front-left.
1 alert head forward, weight gently over front paws, hips still seated, tail starting to uncurl.
2 chest inclines forward over planted forepaws, pelvis starts lifting slightly, hind paws draw under hips.
3 halfway lifted hips, front legs supporting, hind knees still deeply bent, tail unfolding behind.
4 hips lift farther, back flattens, hind joints partly straighten, tail now mostly behind.
5 nearly standing, hind legs extend, head and shoulders settle toward standing height.
6 weight settles on all four paws, almost the neutral standing pose.
7 exactly the neutral standing pose of the third reference first cell, tail behind-left.
Prioritize genuine gradual anatomical in-betweens, planted paws, no eight duplicates. Forward playback rises, reverse playback sits down. The sitting cat's head size MUST MATCH standing head size, so the sit-to-stand sequence won't swell or shrink.
assets.correctionPrompt: Edit target: this seated-to-standing eight-pose cat atlas. Correct the layout and proportions only. Preserve the eight gradual consecutive rising poses and exact cat identity/brushwork. Strict FOUR columns TWO rows, eight equal cells, 2:1 transparent canvas. Scale all eight cats uniformly down by 22%, leaving wide fully transparent gutters, every paw, tail and whisker inside its cell; no cat can touch or cross a cell boundary. Same head size and anatomical scale across all eight cats. Align all cats to the same within-cell ground line at 82% height, centered horizontally. In final two frames settle into a lower, relaxed four-paw standing stance with the head and torso in right-facing three-quarter side profile; avoid a tall straight-legged statue. No background, labels, ground shadows or painted checkerboard. True alpha transparency.
